fact: Bananas are botanically berries, but strawberries are not.
Bamboo is the fastest-growing woody plant in the world, capable of growing up to three feet in a single day.
Sunflowers are not single flowers, but clusters of hundreds of tiny individual flowers called florets.
Vanilla flavoring comes from the cured seed pods of a specific climbing orchid native to Mexico.
Coffee beans are not actually beans, but the seeds of red berries produced by coffee bushes.
The Venus flytrap counts the touches on its hairs to prevent closing on non-food items.
Watermelons are comprised of roughly ninety-two percent water.
The corpse flower produces the largest unbranched cluster of flowers on Earth and smells like rotting meat.
Carrots were originally purple or yellow before Dutch farmers selectively bred orange ones in the sixteenth century.
Broccoli, kale, cabbage, and Brussels sprouts are all variants of the exact same plant species, Brassica oleracea.
Pineapple plants take up to three years to grow and mature a single fruit.
Peanuts do not grow on trees; they mature entirely underground.

The sensitive plant folds its leaves inward within seconds of being touched to deter herbivores.
Walking palms can slowly shift their location by growing new roots in one direction while old roots die off.
Rainbow eucalyptus trees naturally shed their bark to reveal vibrant shades of green, blue, purple, and orange.

Some species of orchids perfectly mimic female insects in shape and scent to trick male insects into pollinating them.

Grapefruit was created in Barbados as a natural hybrid between an orange and a pomelo.

The seeds of the lotus plant can survive extreme drought and temperatures, germinating centuries later.

Sea grasses are the only flowering plants that grow and complete their entire life cycle underwater in oceans.

Watermelons belong to the same plant family as cucumbers, squashes, and pumpkins.

The giant sequoia can live for over three thousand years due to its resistance to disease and fire.

The bark of the cork oak tree can be harvested every nine to twelve years without killing the tree.
The Venus flytrap takes about ten days to completely digest a single trapped insect.

The lotus flower can regulate its own temperature, keeping itself warm even when the surrounding air is cold.
Avocado seeds are surrounded by a bitter layer to discourage animals from chewing and destroying them.

The corpse flower uses purple coloring and heat to make its bloom look and smell like real carrion.
